subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The / God / is / omniscient.
solution:
The correct answer is:** The**

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• When you use 'God' it means it is just one defined being.
 
• Therefore doesn't need an indefinite article because it is a definite one, nor a definite article to differentiate between it and others, because it is only one.
 
• Therefore, the correct sentence should be: **God is omniscient ***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In which cases can we use definite article before 'God'? 

 
 
• when you have an OF: The God of Israel. Or: the God of Hinduism. Or: the god of love
